capabilities: Render only the basename of nested tags in preview mode
Support editor mode and frontmatter tag rendering
Apply basename-tag text changes to tags in properties
Add a basename-tag CSS class for custom styling
extras: The README states the plugin is not actively maintained, issues may not be resolved promptly, and pull requests are welcome.
problem: Obsidian shows the full nested tag path in reading and editing views, which is visually noisy when only the last segment matters.
summary: Tag renderer that displays only the basename of nested tags in preview and editor modes while keeping the nested structure available.
